findings: [33] «Кренкебель» for «Кренкебиль» (one-letter slip in the name); rendered Crainquebille.
[56] «всё окружающее: Тишина» — a colon followed by a capital letter; evidently a period was meant, and the English uses a period.
[69] «Вы не настаиваете, И вы имеете» — a comma followed by a capital И; rendered as one sentence with lowercase “and.”
[97] «Отведенный снова с тюрьму» — «с» for «в» ('into prison'); translated as 'Taken back to prison'.
[145] Attribution printed «Анатол Франс» (soft sign missing; the subtitle has «Анатоля Франса»); rendered Anatole France.
disposition: Retain the audited Russian source and SHA-256 unchanged. None of these readings affects meaning, so the unit is not held out of reviewed status; Confirm against the printed volume 41 at the next print-witness pass.
